description: The Czech Ministry of Agriculture keeps the summary register of water structures classified into categories I to III of technical safety supervision (technickobezpečnostní dohled, TBD) of water works. MZe produced the register and publishes it as an XLS file; the current file gives the state at 31 December 2025 and was published on 24 March 2026. Coverage is the water works in categories I to III across Czechia; a separate MZe list covers significant works of category IV. It is a free download on the ministry portal, and no licence is stated. Caveats: the page does not describe the columns, and the file records the classification of each work in a category. Simulation uses: an inventory of supervised dams for flood hazard exposure and dam-break emergency planning. Related records: the Czech water utility benchmarking (data-czech-mze-water-utility-benchmarking-vak), the Italian large dams list (data-italy-grandi-dighe-italiane) and the Spanish dam inventory (data-spain-dam-reservoir-inventory).
